DELIVERABLE: Read .omo/evidence/ulw/01a05f5f-031b-748b-a611-c92954a4249a/a1/audit-synthesis.md and its domain report. Add focused regression tests before production edits, capture the exact RED output, implement the smallest fixes, capture GREEN output, and write a bounded evidence report at .omo/evidence/ulw/01a05f5f-031b-748b-a611-c92954a4249a/a2/L1-contracts.md.
SCOPE: Production writes are limited to src/flashcards_generator/domain/ports/flashcard_generator.py, src/flashcards_generator/domain/entities.py, src/flashcards_generator/application/dto/generate_request.py, and src/flashcards_generator/application/dto/merge_request.py. Test writes are limited to tests/unit/test_entities.py, tests/unit/test_value_objects.py, tests/unit/test_use_cases.py, and any one new contract test under tests/unit. Address synthesis behaviors B1-B3: GenerationResult must construct from a clean import; Deck.deduplicate must reject non-finite and out-of-range thresholds before mutation; MergeCsvRequest.output_filename must be a nonempty relative basename. Delete only the two proven redundant _=Path assignments if no behavior changes. Do not edit other files, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, reports, or commit.
VERIFY: Before each behavior edit, run its exact named test or clean-process command and record nonzero RED output in the evidence report; after editing run uv run pytest tests/unit/test_entities.py tests/unit/test_value_objects.py tests/unit/test_use_cases.py -q and the clean-process GenerationResult and DTO commands, all with exit code 0. Run LSP diagnostics for every changed production file. Re-read the report and ensure it lists changed files, RED/GREEN commands, and any unverified residual risk.
STOP WHEN: The bounded lane report exists with real RED and GREEN transcripts, the scoped tests pass in one run, diagnostics report no errors, and only the declared production/test paths were edited.

DELIVERABLE: Read .omo/evidence/ulw/01a05f5f-031b-748b-a611-c92954a4249a/a1/audit-synthesis.md and the PDF audit. STOP WHEN: The lane report exists with real RED and GREEN transcripts, the scoped tests pass in one run, diagnostics report no errors, and only the declared paths were edited.

DELIVERABLE: Read .omo/evidence/ulw/01a05f5f-031b-748b-a611-c92954a4249a/a1/audit-synthesis.md and the adapter audit. Add focused mocked subprocess regression tests before production edits, capture exact RED output, implement the smallest safe fixes, capture GREEN output, and write .omo/evidence/ulw/01a05f5f-031b-748b-a611-c92954a4249a/a2/L5-adapter.md.
SCOPE: Production writes are limited to src/flashcards_generator/adapters/notebooklm_adapter.py, src/flashcards_generator/infrastructure/notebooklm_client.py, and new narrowly scoped domain exceptions only if the existing exception contract cannot express the verified boundary errors. Test writes are limited to tests/unit/test_notebooklm_adapter.py, tests/unit/test_adapter_edge_cases.py, tests/unit/test_adapter_list_delete.py, tests/unit/test_notebooklm_client.py, and tests/integration/test_client_integration.py. Address verified behaviors B19-B23: nonzero subprocess status cannot be accepted as success; requested timeouts are real subprocess deadlines; timeout/KeyboardInterrupt cleanup does not leak child processes; malformed/wrong-shaped JSON and empty IDs/cards become typed contextual failures; retries distinguish transient from permanent failures; stderr/auth details are summarized and secrets redacted; adapter and client use one consistent argv/status contract. Preserve shell=False/list argv and public port signatures. Do not edit CLI, use_cases, unrelated source/tests, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, reports, or commit.
VERIFY: For each behavior, run its exact mocked regression test RED before production editing and the same test GREEN afterward; then uv run pytest tests/unit/test_notebooklm_adapter.py tests/unit/test_adapter_edge_cases.py tests/unit/test_adapter_list_delete.py tests/unit/test_notebooklm_client.py tests/integration/test_client_integration.py -q. Use subprocess mocks that preserve timeout/kill/status semantics, no live auth, and no fixed sleeps. Run LSP diagnostics for every changed production file. Re-read the report and prove no raw secret/stderr appears in logs.
STOP WHEN: The lane report exists with real RED and GREEN transcripts, all scoped tests pass in one run, diagnostics report no errors, and only the declared paths were edited.
